brief: A strawberry tower for a small balcony: one planter three storeys tall in the middle, ringed by six planters two storeys tall. Fill every planter with soil and plant strawberries in all seven, with a fruiting plant in the middle one.

finish.summary: Built a 7-cell tower: 3-storey centre with 3-deep drained planter holding a fruiting (harvest-stage) strawberry, ringed by six 2-storey cells each with a 2-deep drained planter holding young strawberries. All 7 planters filled with soil and planted; check_build clear, top view shows all plants.

lines.label: Bin, full depth, drained, 2 stories deep
Bin, full depth, drained, 3 stories deep
Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Building your strawberry tower — tall center, six around it, all planted.
